# h3_ovn_vpc (Resource)

**Deprecated:** use `h3_vpc`; this alias is removed in 1.0. Manages the VPC of a project. The platform has one VPC per project and its ID equals the project ID. Every argument change replaces the VPC (the API has no update), so remove networks first. Routes of the VPC are managed with `h3_vpc_route`; `static_routes` is deprecated and refused by the API.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) VPC name

### Optional

- `namespaces` (List of String) Namespaces attached to the VPC. Optional: the project namespace is used when omitted.
- `project_id` (String) Project ID (UUID). Defaults to the provider `project_id` (`H3_PROJECT_ID`). Changing it replaces the VPC.
- `static_routes` (Attributes List, Deprecated) Deprecated: the API refuses static routes at VPC creation since 04.11.2026. Use `h3_vpc_route`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--static_routes))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) VPC ID (equals the project ID)
- `status` (String) VPC status (`CREATING`, `ACTIVE`)

<a id="nestedatt--static_routes"></a>
### Nested Schema for `static_routes`

Required:

- `cidr` (String) Destination CIDR
- `next_hop_ip` (String) Next hop IP address

Optional:

- `policy` (String) Routing policy (`policyDst` by default)
